name: Agony the Ghost
subjectPrompt: The ghost of a mutinous tiefling sailor aboard a fantasy space galleon. One lean androgynous adult tiefling spirit with two swept-back weathered horns, peaked ears, long dark wind-loosened hair, a crooked sardonic smile and pale luminous lavender eyes. Historically plausible worn maritime clothes: loose linen shirt, worn dark aubergine short sailor's coat with a copper clasp, dark breeches, a knotted sash and a short frayed belt rope. Ghostly smoky blue-plum tint, softly fading edges on feet, coat hems and slim pointed tail, with the fully visible head and torso crisp and well defined. Float gently above a faint ground shadow, one open hand slightly raised as if addressing a crew. No hat, no armor, no weapons. The second reference only establishes tiefling anatomy and local clothing vocabulary; create an entirely separate character.

name: Anvilwrought Raptor Familiar
subjectPrompt: A tiny magical metal hunting-bird familiar, a falcon-shaped construct of dark burnished bronze and copper. The full bird is seen in an elegant three-quarter view, hovering just off the parchment plane with both wings outstretched and talons gently tucked, each whole wing and short layered tail in frame. Individually fitted feather-shaped metal blades with fine etched lines, a sharp hooked metal beak, small gemstone amber eyes, modest rivets and real hinge joints integrated into the bird's anatomy; restrained traces of red copper patina. Finely machined like an ancient Greek artisan's work, no modern gears or engines. Compact bird-sized silhouette. Use the second reference for the metallic avian creature design only, invent a new pose and preserve the contrast and texture of the parchment style reference.
